subtitle: Search, play, discover and download music, in the Kultr design.
localizedDescription:
KultrDL finds music on YouTube Music, YouTube, SoundCloud and Bandcamp, and opens links from Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Tidal, Qobuz and Amazon Music, playing them from the matching recording with the catalogue's own tags and cover.

• For you: new releases from the artists you play, Daily Mixes, Release Radar, Discover, albums for you and albums missing from your collection — worked out on your iPhone once a day, with alerts for new releases.
• It learns from what you play, skip, heart, save and download, and if you like from the Music app, your Navidrome, Last.fm and ListenBrainz.
• Play anything: a queue, the lock screen, Control Center and AirPlay.
• Karousel: tap shuffle twice and, when the queue runs out, music like what was playing keeps coming — even offline, from your own music.
• Download as FLAC, MP3, AAC, Opus, ALAC, WAV or Ogg Vorbis, at the quality you choose, with title, artist, album, track numbers and cover art inside.
• Send downloads straight to your NAS or computer over SFTP, FTPS or FTP, into Artist or Artist/Album folders — or straight into your Navidrome.
• Block artists: their songs, and songs they're on, are hidden everywhere.
• Downloads show in the Files app, so any player can open them.
• Favourites, saved tracks, your own playlists, albums and playlists from any service, listening history.
• Liquid glass on iOS 26, colours from the artwork of what's playing.
• Backups that move between KultrDL for iOS and Android.

No yt-dlp or ffmpeg needed: the stream finding, challenge solving and conversion are built in, and YouTube's clients update themselves.

Free and open source: github.com/evropiani/KultrDL_iOS

privacy.NSAppleMusicUsageDescription: KultrDL suggests music from what you have and play in the Music app, and plays the songs stored on this iPhone in your mixes.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: KultrDL sends downloads to your FTP or SFTP server, which may be on your home network.
